scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @rekt-ink/api & npm run dev -w @rekt-ink/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/web
scripts.test: npm run verify:core && npm run verify:source && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/web
scripts.verify: npm run verify:core && npm run verify:source && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
